_about: Hand-entered facts for the redesign that cannot be derived from the Audio/, Videos/ or Images/ folders. scripts/build_redesign.py merges these with releases.json, videos.json, Audio/*/links.txt, the MP3/MP4 files and the press kit ZIP. Release dates come from Audio/*/links.txt (verified against Apple Music on 2026-11-06).

artist.name: Ash Stu
artist.description: Ash Stu (formerly known as Ashton Stubblefield) is an outsider-folk singer-songwriter from Guthrie, Oklahoma, United States, who writes, performs, and self-releases original music.
artist.tagline: A figment of my own imagination.
